title: Evolve Krav Maga

services.name: Combat and Sparring
services.desc: Krav Maga was Developed by the Israeli Defense Force as the most practical form of Self-Defense. We use not just technique, but a Self-Defense system. We define that as: Krav Maga does not fight fair! There are no rules in the street, so we don't apply rules to ourselves. Striking the eyes, throat, groin, and back of the head are some of the best ways to defend yourself, and are illegal in all combat sports. Neither are knives, guns, sticks, or other weapons. We will teach you how to deal with those threats, including disarming an opponent or using weapons/tools to your advantage! The goal is to survive, and we'll teach you
